title: More Speedrun
description: adds more fun things to help with speedrunning very chaotic too
body:
the speedrun mod:

totem of completion:can be obtained by trading with a c leric villager when eaten you get every advancement

Villager Loot Tables:Villagers Officially drop 27 iron blocks

Dave The Magical Cheese wizard:every tick he drops a blaze rod can spawn in any bioem too

Steve:steve can be found in any nether biome except for the basalt deltas when right clicked gives you lava chicken

Lava Chicken:when eaten you get speed 255 and jump boost 100 only lasts for 30 second

Dirt Is Diamonds:dirt drops diamonds the loot tables are destroyed:)

Rabbits Are Netherite:Rabbits drop netherite blocks ingots and upgrades

N keybind:when pressed N on keyboard it wil give you obsidian and flint and steelt o go to the nether

Magical Pickle: if you craft 1 magical pickle with 1 eye of ender you get a magical pickle when eaten gives you enough resources to enter the end

Sword Of Doom:if you craft a diamond sword with 1 lava chicken you get the 1 shot sword

that's all for the speedrun enjoy☻
